name: [Katagami] Humans are hitting errors on katagami.ai
message:
Ten or more browser errors on katagami.ai in the last hour. This is the human half of the friction picture — the MCP monitors only see agents.

Group by @error.message and @view.url_path to find the page. A spike on one route after a deploy is a regression; a steady trickle is usually a third-party or extension.
